selector.rationale: The patient presented with an inflamed, infiltrating, necrotic lesion over the pacemaker implant site, which is consistent with a pacemaker pocket infection. The presence of Staphylococcus epidermidis in the lesion also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: The presence of Staphylococcus epidermidis and the location of the lesion over the implant site make this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Device-related infection
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes pacemaker pocket infection, but is not as specific

rejected.label: Staphylococcal infection
rejected.why: While Staphylococcus epidermidis was present, this diagnosis does not specifically address the location and nature of the infection

rejected.label: Antibiotic-resistant infection
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence that the infection is resistant to antibiotics
